label: early original-phase input of s/b/l (t=1-3)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase (99% of mass) at early positions t=1-4 (t=1 holds 50% of mass, t=2 33%, t=3 14%; never at t=0 or on the delimiter, and nearly never in the copy phase). It is token-selective: input s (38% of mass), b (28%), l (19%), then a and d, with weak tails on w and k. It fires mostly on the first occurrence of the token (89% of mass). Only a minority of these token/position steps fire (precision about 0.3), and whether one does depends on the preceding prefix in a way no simple rule captured. Top activations come after prefixes like 1 z, 1 e, 1 h. Fails to fire on the same tokens after prefixes such as q q, 0 1, p. Adding a and d raises mass recall to about 0.96 but lowers precision.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: s, b, l, a, d, w; least: z, j, p, h) and the previous input (most: s, k, b, w, l, n; least: 3, o, q, -); timing cues that raise it most: t=2, t=1, t=3.
